subject: MAP: SOC2 package delivery / Security review - Aurelia Tech
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@aurelia.tech>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: SOC2 package delivery / Security review - Aurelia Tech

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the time today. Quick post-call recap and draft MAP attached (PDF). Per our conversation, the immediate MAP milestone is the security review and SOC 2 package delivery so your security team can complete their assessment. High-level ask / next steps: \

- Redwood deliverables (this week):
  - SOC 2 questionnaire (attached: redwood_soc2_questionnaire_v1.docx)
  - Evidence inventory spreadsheet (attached: soc2_evidence_inventory.xlsx) with sample artifacts we can share
  - MAP draft PDF (attached) with milestones, owners, and target dates
- Your team deliverables:
  - Confirm which artifacts you need as PDFs vs. summaries
  - Share procurement contact and preferred DocuSign flow if you need an MSA/NDA completed before evidence exchange

Proposed milestone dates (from draft MAP):
- Evidence inventory delivered by Redwood: 2026-06-26
- Full SOC2 package (questionnaire + sample artifacts) delivered by Redwood: 2026-06-28
- Aurelia security review complete / final questions: target 2026-07-08
- Target commercial close: 2026-07-15

Dependencies: signed NDA/DocuSign (if required), procurement timeline, and confirmation of which artifacts are needed in full.

Marcus (SE) is looped in to provide technical artifact details and to coordinate secure transfer. Priyom is looped in for procurement/contract touchpoints.

Can you confirm the proposed dates and whether your security team needs anything beyond what’s attached? If OK, we’ll mark the MAP milestone as targeted and schedule a short handoff meeting between Marcus and your security lead.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: MAP-draft-aurelia-20260624.pdf; redwood_soc2_questionnaire_v1.docx; soc2_evidence_inventory.xlsx

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@aurelia.tech>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aurelia Security <security@aurelia.tech>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: SOC2 package delivery / Security review - Aurelia Tech

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear MAP. A couple quick clarifications from our side: \

1) For the evidence inventory, can you flag which items are considered PII-sensitive and whether they will be delivered redacted or as summaries? Our policy team prefers redacted samples unless we sign an SRA/NDA.
2) Does Redwood provide system-generated logs (e.g., access logs, admin activity) as CSV exports or do you provide a summarized extract?
3) Procurement: please add our procurement lead (cc’d on my next note) to the MAP. We may need to review the MSA in parallel; do you have a standard SOW we can review?

Target dates look OK but can you confirm the evidence delivery method (secure share vs. signed SFTP)? Also please confirm who the point-of-contact for the evidence handoff will be.

If we can get the inventory and a few sample artifacts by end-of-week (06/28) that would help our security team triage.

Thanks — I’ll loop procurement in separately.
Jordan
Jordan Smith
Head of IT Security | Aurelia Tech
jordan.smith@aurelia.tech | +1 (617) 555-4433

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@aurelia.tech>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: SOC2 package delivery / Security review - Aurelia Tech

Jordan — thanks, good questions. Quick answers and committed actions: \

- PII / sensitive artifacts: we will flag sensitive items in the evidence inventory and provide redacted samples by default. If Aurelia’s procurement/security needs full artifacts we’ll request an executed SRA/NDA before full transfer.
- Logs / exports: Marcus will provide system exports as CSVs where available and summarized extracts for aggregated reports.
- Delivery method: secure AWS S3 presigned links (HTTPS) or secure ShareFile; we can use signed SFTP if your ops team requires it. We’ll coordinate with your procurement for the final method.
- POC for evidence handoff: Marcus Lin (marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com) — he’ll own the inventory and artifact delivery.

Committed timeline (updated):
- 2026-06-26: Marcus to send the populated evidence inventory (spreadsheet) with sensitivity flags and a short notes column explaining each artifact
- 2026-06-28: Redwood to share SOC2 questionnaire + redacted sample artifacts via secure link(s)
- 2026-07-08: Aurelia to complete initial review and surface any follow-ups

Priyom — can you confirm whether Aurelia’s procurement contact should be added to the MAP now or after Jordan loops them in?

If that all looks good I’ll update the MAP PDF (milestone table) and we’ll track dependencies in the HubSpot deal (link below).

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachments: redwood_soc2_questionnaire_v1.docx; soc2_evidence_inventory.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@aurelia.tech>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP: SOC2 package delivery / Security review - Aurelia Tech

Jordan / Marissa — following up with the technical artifact plan. Per the inventory I’m attaching a populated sheet and will deliver sample artifacts via secure presigned S3 links by 06/28. Brief list of typical artifacts we’ll include (samples/redacted where applicable):

- Network diagram (redacted for vendor IPs)
- IAM/privileged access policy extracts and admin user list (redacted)
- Change management tickets/logs (summary + one ticket PDF)
- Backup and retention policy + example backup logs
- Incident response runbook (redacted)
- System-generated auth/access logs (CSV exports for the requested timespan)
- SOC2 bridge letter & scope summary (SOC2-bridge-letter.pdf)

Notes: where artifacts contain customer data or PII we’ll provide redacted versions by default and request an executed SRA before sending originals. For the CSV logs, we’ll provide a sampled window and a summarized report to reduce noise.

Deliverables I’ll upload on 2026-06-28 to a secure bucket and send presigned links with expiration and access controls. If Aurelia prefers SFTP let me know and I’ll coordinate with our ops team.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-2201

Attachments: soc2_evidence_inventory.xlsx; SOC2-bridge-letter.pdf

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@aurelia.tech>

Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2026 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: SOC2 package delivery / Security review - Aurelia Tech

Marissa / Marcus — received the inventory and bridge letter, and appreciate the timeline. Procurement is now looped (procurement@aurelia.tech).

We confirm the following:
- Evidence inventory looks good; please flag sensitive items as discussed.
- Presigned S3 links with expirations work for us — please include a short README for each artifact explaining redactions and timestamps.
- Target dates are approved: artifact delivery 06/28; initial review complete by 07/08; target close 07/15.

One quick ask: can you add a one-line summary of the MAP milestone responsibilities into the HubSpot deal record (link below) so procurement can see the milestone and target close date in the commercial record?

I’ll share any follow-up questions from the security review next week.

Thanks,
Jordan
